customTLSFeatures.description: Optional. Custom TLS features that are allowed.

description.description: Optional. Free-text description of the resource.

excludePublicCASet.description: Optional. If True, then the TrustConfig will exclude public CA certificates.

minTLSVersion.description: Optional. Minimum TLS version that is allowed.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

tlsFeatureProfile.description: Optional. TLS feature profile that is allowed.

trustConfigRef.description: Optional. A TrustConfig resource that contains the trust store for validation of client credentials. The TrustConfig resource must be in the format "projects/{project}/locations/{location}/trustConfigs/{trustConfig}".
